'''Mynock Corner''' was an area of [[Brzo's Wells]], within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], it was controlled by [[the Brothers]] [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] and the gang [[Dire Skulls]]. In [[3627 BBY]], an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attacked the location and eliminated the criminals and neutralized an [[Unidentified Arcona (Mek-Sha)|Arcona enslaver]] during a deal.<ref name="TOR:BtY" />
